name: Skater's Balance
body:
Drawbacks
Skater's Balance
Source Kobolds of Golarion pg. 19
Category Race
Requirement(s) Kobold
You grew up stalking across the frozen pools of water that dot your tribe’s Darklands home. You don’t need to spend extra movement to enter a square of an ice sheet (Core Rulebook 430), and the DCs of your Acrobatics checks on ice sheets don’t increase by 5.
